Title: Prerequisites: Docker, images, GPU, model weights on the staging disk
Start HDFS (namenode + datanode) and wait for a live datanode
Upload the model weights into HDFS (/models/weights) and verify byte counts
model_store over WebHDFS: fetch + checksum, missing path, unreachable host
Model server (kitchen) with models from HDFS: fetch into node cache, load on GPU
Call the model server directly (POST /predict, no Spark)
Spark cluster, service mode: lean master + worker POST to the kitchen
Node cache: restarting the kitchen reuses the downloaded models
HDFS outage with a warm cache: kitchen still starts and serves
Master file-system mode: models read from a shared/local path (file://), no HDFS
Cluster (in-process) mode: the Spark executor fetches models from HDFS and runs NER itself
Teardown (keeps HDFS data + node caches unless -Wipe)
